items.name: Flashbang Grenade
items.effect: Applies Stun (1) to everyone within Very Near range, Thrown

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.effect: Deals 2 area (Very Near range) Explosive damage (DC8 to Evade half), Thrown

items.name: EMP Grenade
items.effect: Applies EMP (2) to everything within Near range, Thrown

items.name: Combat Stim Injector
items.effect: Gain +1 action & -1 Stress; take 1 wound after effect ends

items.name: Basic Medkit
items.effect: Right tool for the job: First Aid checks

items.name: Multitool
items.effect: Allows engineering checks to repair, bypass, scrap, etc.

items.name: Repair Kit
items.effect: Provides materials and tools for repairs

items.name: Tracker
items.effect: While within 10km, always know location of this device

items.name: Portable Scanner
items.effect: Right tool for the job: Observe (tech, lifeforms)

items.name: Weapon Scope (mod)
items.effect: Simple Modification. Grants +1 bonus die to called shots at medium range and farther; inflicts +1 penalty die to attacks at Near range or nearer

items.name: Weapon Silencer (mod)
items.effect: Simple Modification. Weapon makes reduced sound when fired; deals -1 damage

items.name: Weapon SMART-link (mod)
items.effect: Grants weapon ability to use SMART ammo.

items.name: Armour Gel Pads (mod)
items.effect: Grants armour Resist (Explosive 1) trait.

items.name: Armour Kevlar Plating (mod)
items.effect: Expert Modification. Grants armour Resist (Ballistic 1) trait.

items.name: Quick Release Harness (mod)
items.effect: Reduces time to put on or take off armour by half (rounded down).

items.name: Reinforced Helmet (mod)
items.effect: Expert Modification. Reduces Called Shot damage bonus by half (rounded up).

items.name: Compact Backpack
items.effect: +5 Inventory Slots when worn.

items.name: Ammo (Flechette)
items.effect: Deals +2 damage to unarmoured targets.

items.name: Ammo (SMART)
items.effect: Requires weapon fit with SMART-link. Negates one level of cover (Full Cover becomes Partial Cover; Partial Cover is negated entirely). Target must be visible and bullets must have a path to reach the target (not necessarily a straight line).

items.name: Ammo (Armour Piercing)
items.effect: Adds Piercing (1) to attacks.

items.name: Ammo (Explosive)
items.effect: Adds Shredding (1) to attacks. Attacks deal Explosive damage.
